name: 10and2
description: The connector for 10 & 2: lets you talk to the coding agents on your computer (T3 Code, Claude Code) from the 10 & 2 iPhone app.
author: Self-Deprecated ApS

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22.13 --format=esm --outfile=dist/10and2.js --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --legal-comments=none
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node --test test/*.test.ts && npm run build && node test/smoke.mjs
